one_liner: Private market intelligence and financial data platform
blocker: API access requires a PitchBook contract with quote-only pricing; API docs are visible only to contracted clients

evidence.quote: The PitchBook API is a RESTful implementation that most HTTP clients can easily access in your chosen language or via a web browser.

evidence.claim: Authentication uses an API key sent in an authorization header with a PB-Token scheme.
evidence.quote: To authenticate to the PitchBook API, simply include a header named "authorization" with the value of "PB-Token {API_KEY}" with each API request

evidence.claim: PitchBook's team provisions API access via key or token, implying a sales/onboarding process.
evidence.quote: Our team will work with you to understand the insights help you establish the API connection through an API key or authentication token.

evidence.claim: API pricing is quote-only and sold as a premium add-on to the core subscription.
evidence.quote: PitchBook does not publish API or Data Feed pricing. Both are premium add-ons to the core platform subscription, Pricing is quote-only.

evidence.claim: Full API documentation is gated behind client authentication.
evidence.quote: The API guide and Endpoints Overview document sit behind platform authentication and are visible only to contracted clients.

notes: A third-party directory (mcpservers.org) lists a hosted PitchBook MCP endpoint at premium.mcp.pitchbook.com and PitchBook markets 'Premium Connector' LLM integrations, but no vendor-owned documentation confirming an official MCP server was found in the supplied material. PitchBook's own pages fetched as tracker-probe snapshots, so details rely on snippets and third-party reviews.
